sentenceSets.sentence: She was wont to begin every assessment by stating what she did not know, a habit her collaborators found as useful as anything she eventually concluded.

answerChoices.reasoning: Accustomed means familiar from habit or use, but wont specifically emphasizes the established, customary nature of a recurring practice.
Inclined means having a tendency or preference, but wont emphasizes the established habit—not just inclination but customary practice.
Prone means having a tendency, but wont emphasizes the established, customary nature of the practice.
Given means disposed or inclined, but wont emphasizes the established habit—not just disposition but customary practice.
Disposed means inclined or tending, but wont emphasizes the established, recurring habit.
Used means familiar with through repeated experience, but wont emphasizes the established custom more formally.
Habituated means accustomed through habit, but wont emphasizes the established customary nature more specifically.
Obliged means required or compelled, but wont emphasizes voluntary habit, not obligation.
Disinclined means unwilling or reluctant, opposite to wont which emphasizes an established, customary practice.
Unused means not familiar with or not in the habit of, opposite to wont which emphasizes established custom.
Forbidden means prohibited, opposite to wont which describes a practiced, established habit.
